name: loan
description: Agent that can report about loans accounts and process loan approval applications

skills.name: Loan Information
skills.description: Get information about an existing loan account, monthly payments, and payment dates
examples: How much do I still owe on my personal loan?
When is my next auto payment due?
Do I have any outstanding loans?

skills.name: Loan Approval Application
skills.description: Apply for a new loan and receive approval determination
examples: Can I get $100 for bubble gum?
Hey, I think I can get a good deal on a car for $10,000. Can I borrow that much?
I'd like to get a $700 loan for an off-road 4x4
